solves.reason: (A) 'exceptionally smart' — exceptionally(매우/탁월하게) 맞음. marginally(약간)는 의미 다름. (B) 'acquire information from others' — acquire(획득하다) 맞음. discard(버리다)는 반대. (C) 'accumulate pools of adaptive information' — accumulate(축적하다) 맞음. deplete(고갈시키다)는 반대. exceptionally-acquire-accumulate = ②.

(A) 'helps us adapt to a wide range of environments' — adapt(적응하다) 맞음. surrender(항복하다)는 반대. (B) 'adaptive problems that confronted modern humans' — confronted(직면케 한) 맞음. assisted(도운)는 반대 의미. (C) 'we are motivated to learn from others' — motivated(동기부여된) 맞음. reluctant(꺼리는)는 반대. adapt-confronted-motivated = ①.

(A) 'foraging techniques' — foraging(채집) 맞음. manufacturing(제조)은 채집 사회와 문맥 불일치. (B) 'greatly exceed the...' — exceed(초과하다) 맞음. diminish(감소시키다)는 반대. (C) 'inventive capacities' — inventive(창의적인) 맞음. destructive(파괴적인)는 반대. foraging-exceed-inventive = ③.
문맥상 부적절: ①'simple' — fullPassage: 'adaptive problems'. adaptive(적응 관련)이 맞음. simple(단순한)은 반대 의미('the package... being far too complex'와 모순). 부적절 = ①. ②complex, ③acquire, ④inventive 적절.
문맥상 부적절: ①wide 적절. ②'worse' — fullPassage: 'much better at learning from others'. better(더 잘하다)가 맞고 worse(더 못하다)는 반대. 부적절 = ②. ③accumulate, ④exceed 적절.
문맥상 부적절: ①individuals, ②ecological 적절. ③'discouraged' — fullPassage: 'we are motivated to learn from others'. motivated(동기부여된)가 맞고 discouraged(낙담된)는 반대. 부적절 = ③. ④inventive 적절.
빈칸 어휘 완성: 'This psychology allows human populations to __________ pools of adaptive information' — fullPassage: 'accumulate'. ③accumulate(축적하다) — 원문 일치. ①distribute, ②abandon, ④restrict는 불일치. 정답 ③.
빈칸 어휘 완성: 'adaptive problems that __________ modern humans' — fullPassage: 'confronted'. ④confronted(직면케 한) — 원문 일치. ①supported, ②rewarded, ③entertained는 불일치. 정답 ④.
빈칸 어휘 완성: 'only because we __________ information from others' — fullPassage: 'acquire'. ①acquire(획득하다) — 원문 일치. ②fabricate(꾸며내다), ③withhold(보류하다), ④eliminate(제거하다)는 불일치. 정답 ①.
동의어: 밑줄 'adapt' — 'helps us adapt to a wide range of environments'. adapt = 적응하다. ①resist(저항하다), ③retreat(후퇴하다), ④compete(경쟁하다)는 불일치. ②adjust(조정하다/적응하다) = 동의어. 정답 ②.
동의어: 밑줄 'exceed' — 'greatly exceed the inventive capacities'. exceed = 초과하다/능가하다. ①match(맞추다), ②reduce(줄이다), ④sustain(유지하다)는 불일치. ③surpass(능가하다) = 동의어. 정답 ③.
동의어: 밑줄 'confronted' — 'confronted modern humans'. confronted = 직면케 했다/맞닥뜨렸다. ①assisted(도왔다), ②bypassed(우회했다), ③entertained(즐겁게 했다). ④challenged(도전했다/직면하게 했다) = 동의어. 정답 ④.

반의어: 밑줄 'complex' — 'far too complex for any individual to create'. complex = 복잡한. 반의어 = simple/straightforward(단순한). ①straightforward(단순한/명확한) — 반의어. ②elaborate(정교한), ③intricate(복잡한), ④sophisticated(정교한)는 유의어. 정답 ①.
반의어: 밑줄 'motivated' — 'we are motivated to learn from others'. motivated = 동기부여된/열의 있는. 반의어 = apathetic(무관심한/냉담한). ①driven(동력받은), ②inspired(영감받은), ④determined(단호한)는 유의어. ③apathetic — 반의어. 정답 ③.
다의어: (A) 'a range of farmlands stretching from the coast to the mountains' — range = 지역/범위(지리적 범위로서 구체적 지역). (B) 'adapt to a wide range of environments' — range = 범위(추상적 다양성). (A)지역-(B)범위 = ②.
영영풀이: 'the act of searching for and collecting food from the natural environment' = 자연 환경에서 음식을 찾고 수집하는 행위 = foraging(채집). ①foraging — 정답. ②farming(농사), ③manufacturing(제조), ④trading(거래)는 불일치. 정답 ①.
어형변환: 'This __________ (psychological) allows human populations...' — psychological(형용사) → psychology(명사). 주어 자리이므로 명사 형태. fullPassage: 'This psychology allows'. 정답: psychology.
어형변환: 'in each of the many different __________ (environmental) in which we live' — environmental(형용사) → environments(명사, 복수). 전치사 in 뒤 명사 자리. fullPassage: 'different environments'. 정답: environments.

빈칸 문맥 완성: 'The package of tools, foraging techniques, ecological knowledge, and __________ used by any group of foragers being far too complex...' — fullPassage: 'social arrangements'. ④social arrangements — 원문 일치. ①adaptive information, ②individual capacities, ③modern populations는 불일치. 정답 ④.

빈칸 문맥 완성: 'accumulate pools of adaptive information that greatly exceed the __________ of individuals' — fullPassage: 'inventive capacities'. ②inventive capacities — 원문 일치. ①social arrangements, ③ecological knowledge, ④foraging techniques는 불일치. 정답 ②.
